## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

Describe the checks you ran and their results.

- [ ] I ran the existing Manifestor EditMode tests, or explained why they could not be run.
- [ ] I searched for stale references after compile-sensitive renames or API changes.
- [ ] I manually verified affected Editor workflows where automated coverage was not practical.

## Change checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated formatting or generated files.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented where appropriate.
- [ ] User-facing release changes update both the repository and package changelogs.
- [ ] Serialized field or type changes preserve compatibility or include a migration strategy.
- [ ] `Library`, `Temp`, IDE metadata, generated schemas, and other local Unity artifacts are excluded.
